target.name: xx Packaging glass, brown, at regional storage

strategy.label: structural model: the rebuilt 'at plant' node plus distribution transport, distances calibrated
strategy.note: An 'at regional storage' dataset is its 'at plant' product plus the transport to the regional store - the shape every non-aggregated 'at regional storage' unit process in BAFU has. One kilogram of the rebuilt brown packaging glass node is taken as the input and the two transport distances are fitted against the aggregated vector.

evidence.source: reverse-bafu: rebuilt 'xx Packaging glass, brown, at plant' [CH] node
evidence.note: The at-plant spec in this same run supplies the product.
